features: Fast & Efficient Charging – Delivers up to 45W of fast and efficient charging for compatible Pixel devices and other USB-C enabled devices.
USB PD 3.1 PPS Technology – Supports USB Power Delivery (PD) 3.1 PPS for optimized, reliable charging with compatible devices.
Made for Google Devices – Designed to charge Pixel phones, Pixel Buds, and compatible laptops through a USB-C connection.
Universal USB-C Compatibility – Features a USB-C port and is compatible with a wide range of USB-C enabled devices.
Sustainable Design – Built with a polycarbonate housing containing at least 47% recycled plastic and shipped in 100% plastic-free packaging (excluding specified exceptions).
description: The 45W USB-C Power Charger delivers fast and efficient charging for all your Pixel devices
